description: Per-workspace automatic worker delivery (commit → push → draft PR → CI).

workspaces.notes: Worker delivery opens draft PRs into development. Production web (Vercel) tracks main — merge development→preview→main only after CI green; production OTA/Play remain hard-gated.
Worker delivery opens private draft PRs into master. TPS currently has no configured CI workflows; verification receipts remain mandatory before publication.
Worker delivery opens draft PRs into main. Parent app and Expo work remain owned by DashPro; this repository contains the private centre operations workspace and desktop command centre.

Worker delivery opens draft PRs into MoveIT's standalone private repository. Service keys resolve through the current-platform vault bridge; no operator .env is required when vault has the declared keys. CI workflow tracking is pending a GitHub token with workflow scope.
